structure: antennal sensilla, all types and subtypes summed
measurement: estimated total number of antennal sensilla, female (Table 6 Total row; read as per antenna, n = 6 antennae per sex; the table does not print a unit)
method: scanning electron microscopy of antennae; per-type numbers calculated as segment area times sensillum density, summed
conditions: Adults collected with hanging traps in the forest (Beijing Zhongjie Sifang Biotechnology Model L002) containing mainly pinene, L-beta-pinene and (1S)-(+)-3-carene as attractants at Hexi Village, Shangjiahe Town, Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County, Liaoning (41.85-41.86 N, 124.37-124.38 E); Methods 2.1 gives no collection date. Antennae, maxillary palps and labial palps were removed from January to August 2022 (Methods 2.2), fixed in 2.5% glutaraldehyde 12 h at 4 C, dehydrated in graded ethanol and acetone, air dried 24 h, gold-coated (about 20 nm). Six antennae per sex were observed, three on the dorsal surface and three on the ventral surface (Methods 2.2). Segment area was calculated as length times width (Methods 2.4) and density is per 10^5 um2 (Table 5 note). Table 6 footnote: 'The number of each sensillum type/subtype was calculated by multiplying the area of each segment by the corresponding sensillum density and summing the results.' So the total is an estimate from density on one surface per antenna and a rectangular area, not a direct count of every sensillum. Data mean±SE, n=6 per sex. Eight sensillum types were identified (Abstract); Table 6 sums 12 types/subtypes (its twelve row means add to the Total within rounding). Letters a/b in the row mark a significant female/male difference (t-test, P<0.05); males carry more in total, while STI, BB, SChII and DSO are higher in females. No Results sentence states the totals.

structure: aedeagal sensilla basiconica, upper side of the median lobe (lobe 1)
measurement: number of sensilla basiconica counted on the upper side of one median lobe
method: scanning electron microscopy of the dissected aedeagus; counts by sensillum type on one side of one median lobe
conditions: Nine males collected near Greifswald, northeastern Germany were dissected; aedeagi cleaned by ultrasound and in potassium hydroxide, mounted on SEM stubs, gold-palladium coated. Results count four median lobes from four males, each on a different side (upper, lower, left, right), and the counts differ widely: s. basiconica 35 (upper side, lobe 1), 9 (lower side, lobe 2), 5 (left side, lobe 3), 22 (right side, lobe 4); s. mamilliformia 11, 31, 8, 31; s. cupuliformia 54, 52, 59, 22. This record is lobe 1 only, as the sentence states; it is not a species mean. Whether the lobe was wet or dry is not stated in what was read.
